g.text: The market turned. The exit became law.
European sales rose 11%in 2025 — the first growthsince 2022
2024 brought Europe's largestdecline ever recorded: −21%,Germany almost −50%. Then in 2025heat pumps outsold gas boilers inEurope for the first time.
EPBD Article 17(15) ended incentives for new stand-alone fossil boilers in 2025; plans must reach full phase-out by 2040.
Sources: IEA Global Energy Review 2025 and 2026 · European Commission, Energy · retrieved 2026-09-10
